newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile shares end lower, rebound seen on rates cut.
newsitem.headline: Chile shares end lower, rebound seen on rates cut.

text.p: Chilean blue chips closed slightly lower in moderate volume, but stocks are likely to shoot higher at the opening following news the Central Bank has cut interest rates, said dealers.
"Although the reduction is small, the bolsa will interpret it positively as many people will think it is the end of the (economic) adjustment," said one dealer.
News of the lower rates was announced after Santiago's financial markets had closed.
The selective index ended down 0.07 percent at 111.63 points.
The general index shed 0.28 percent at 5,209.21 points on volume of 8.3 billion pesos.
The bank said it has cut daily interbank interest rates by 0.25 percent, in the first easing of its restrictive monetary policy which has been in force for the last year.
Losers included telecom Telex, down 2.88 percent at 1,010 pesos, Banco Security, down 2.5 percent at 390 pesos and forestry firm Cholguan, which shed 2.36 percent to 290 pesos.
Winners included drug-maker LabChile, up 2.78 percent at 370 pesos and fishing company Itata which was up 2.73 percent at 94 pesos.
